mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (tag_id, name, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId}), #{name}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM tag WHERE tag_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId})
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(tag_id) AS tag_id, name, created_at FROM tag
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(tag_id) AS tag_id, name, created_at FROM tag WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(tag_id) AS tag_id, name, created_at FROM tag WHERE tag_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tag WHERE tag_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId})
